text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: KMS-decrypt-errors-High - page fired (PD-INC-4321). Error rate for kms.decrypt is 12% over the last 3m, 429s and 404 key-not-found spikes from KMS/HSM cluster in us-west-2. Auto-escalation scheduled in 3m unless acked.
Samir Patel: acked. jumping on it. any idea if this is rotation-related?
Keiko Tanaka: seeing lots of `KeyNotFound` in logs; correlate with rotation job from config-service at ~1779000600. rotation job reported success but retries look suspicious.
Maria Gomez: I can pull the KMS audit log, give me 30s. customers on Dedicated may be affected (some decrypt calls failing -> request retries).
cryptng: pinging HSM vendor support. provisioning/rotation did run yesterday for the key alias `rw-inference-prod-main`. vendor ticket #HSM-998 attached.
Samir Patel: mitigation plan: 1) stop config-service rotations (if still running) 2) fall back to software cache for recent keys 3) route new decrypt requests to replica cluster in us-east-1 4) alert SRE and crypto.
oncall-rotation: Samir noted. handoff scheduled at +30m if not resolved.
Keiko Tanaka: quick check, output from KMS: ```
2026-03-14T13:45:12Z ERROR decrypt failed keyId="alias/rw-inference-prod-main" code=KeyNotFound
2026-03-14T13:45:13Z WARN decrypt retry attempt=1
2026-03-14T13:45:15Z ERROR decrypt throttled code=ThrottlingException
```
Maria Gomez: audit log shows a key-state transition `PENDING_DEACTIVATION -> ACTIVE` at 13:44:58 but the HSM didn't return the wrapped key material for a subset of shards. looks like rotation partially completed.
Samir Patel: ok, stop further rotations: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment/config-service --replicas=0` (runbook step 2). Maria, can you export the affected key IDs so we can re-import?
Maria Gomez: exporting list now: `alias/rw-inference-prod-main`, `alias/rw-inference-prod-replica-1`. sending secure link to SRE channel.
cryptng: vendor says we hit an internal HSM throttle threshold because the rotation happened concurrently across 8 partitions. they're lifting soft throttle per request but need a manual validation step to re-attach wrapped key material. ETA 20-45m.
Samir Patel: temporary mitigation: enable software fallback for decrypts for up to 120s TTL using cached-wrapped-key for existing tokens. Command: `FEATURE_KMS_SOFT_FALLBACK=1` applied to runtime pool. Doing gradual rollout to avoid cache stampede.
Keiko Tanaka: rolling out flag to 20% of hosts now: ``kubectl set env deployment/inference-runtime FEATURE_KMS_SOFT_FALLBACK=1 -n inference --record``
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PD-INC-4321 acknowledged by Samir Patel. Escalation paused.
Maria Gomez: re-import attempt: we have wrapped material for 92% shards. one shard still missing; vendor says manual unwrap and push required. I have a runbook section for manual import.
Samir Patel: good. Maria, follow runbook steps 4-6 and note exact shard IDs you had to recreate. cryptng, keep vendor in the loop and ask for expedited recovery for that shard.
cryptng: vendor updated; they created support ticket HSM-998-URG with our incident ref PD-INC-4321. They will perform a manual key attach to shard-07 at 13:56Z.
Keiko Tanaka: monitoring redirect metrics: decrypt success rate climbed from 88% -> 98% after soft-fallback rollout to 40% of hosts. latency bump ~15ms p50.
Samir Patel: good sign. set customer impact: "Partial decrypt failures for a subset of requests from us-west-2 between 13:45 and 14:00 UTC; retries transparent for most customers but some requests returned 404/429 to callers. Investigating potential replay/duplicate behavior; recommend temporary rate-limiting on client side if possible."
Maria Gomez: vendor confirmed manual attach for shard-07 complete at 13:59:18Z. performing validation now.
cryptng: validation logs: ``VALIDATION PASS: shard-07 reattached, all key IDs valid``.
Maria Gomez: final check: running end-to-end decrypt against sample artifact: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/decrypt -d '{"ciphertext":"..."}'` -> 200.
Samir Patel: ok rolling back software fallback now that primary KMS healthy. `kubectl set env deployment/inference-runtime FEATURE_KMS_SOFT_FALLBACK=0 -n inference --record` Rollback on 2-step: 100% after 10m if no regressions.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PD-INC-4321 status: resolved by Samir Patel; incident duration ~14m. Please fill incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/incident/PD-INC-4321 and include timeline + customer impact.
oncall-rotation: handoff: Samir -> Keiko at 14:10 UTC. Keiko will verify post-incident monitoring for 60m.
Keiko Tanaka: acked. I'll add a follow-up action: add staggered rotation orchestration and a pre-check for shard availability before marking rotation complete. filing ticket INFRA-2320.
Samir Patel: notes for postmortem: better throttling controls for HSM bulk operations, auto-backoff per-shard, and a grace-window for key-availability checks. Also add callout to Dedicated customers to expect transient 429/404s during rotation windows.
Maria Gomez: uploading logs and runbook step outcome to the incident doc.
Samir Patel: thanks everyone :thumbsup: closing thread.
